newsitem.title: USA: MFRI sets special meeting for merger vote.
newsitem.headline: MFRI sets special meeting for merger vote.

text.p: MFRI Inc said Monday it will hold a special stockholder meeting December 16 to count proxy votes on a proposed merger with Midwesco Inc.

The acquisition of Midwesco and its Thermal Care division is expected to add $20 million in sales, MFRI said. The company also posted record third-quarter net income of $1.2 million, up 33 percent from earnings of $897,000 one year ago.
MFRI manufactures and markets filter bags under the Midwesco Filter brand name and specialty piping systems under the Perma-Pipe name.
